liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Listener was moved to tears by the Morning Dew [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **In the Midnight Hour**: rare: 10 archived performances [16]
- **Hey Jude**: rare: 13 archived performances [16]
- **Passenger**: rare: 9 archived performances [16]
- **Spanish Jam**: rare: 8 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **deadco2025-08-02.mk4** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 179 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Listener finds this recording very crisp [15]
- **deadco2025-08-02**: source not stated; 21 songs; 179 min [3]
- **deadco2025-08-02.ejl6495**: source not stated; 21 songs; 186 min [4]
- **deadandco2025-08-02.schoeps.spyder9.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 185 min [5]
- **deadandco2025-08-02.nak1k.spyder9.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 185 min [6]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Mayoral [1]
- Listener first caught this show through the live stream on NUGS [10]
- Show took place at the Polo Fields, celebrating 60 years of Grateful Dead music [3]
- Set one opened with a greeting and introduction from Mayor Daniel Lurie [3]
- Lineup listed: Weir, Hart, Mayer and Oteil Burbridge [4]
- This was day two of the GD60 San Francisco run, August 1-3, 2025 [5]
- This was day two of the GD60 San Francisco run, August 1-3, 2025 [6]
- Listener ranks this as the strongest of the three nights [12]
- Listener ranks this as the strongest of the three nights [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2025-08-02.mk4**: taped by Oren Levy; transferred by Oren Levy; source: Schoeps MK4 3060 spaced > Mixpre 6 II [1]
- **deadco2025-08-02**: taped by Z-Man; transferred by Z-Man; source: Schoeps CCM4V'S>Sound Devices Mix-Pre 6 II (48/32) [3]. Also: Recorded and seeded by Z-Man with Schoeps CCM4V mics into a Sound Devices Mix-Pre 6 II, with K-Mac assisting [3]
- **deadco2025-08-02.ejl6495**: taped by Eric Lugassy; transferred by Eric Lugassy; source: B9 Audio C31F Wide Cardioids > nbob actives > baby nbox > Tascam Fr-AV2 32 bit float/ 96 [4]. Also: Taped from the official tapers section left of the board, about 14 feet high, using B9 C31F cardioids into a Tascam FR-AV2; Chain ran from SD card to WAV, then Reaper, then 24-bit FLAC [4]
- **deadandco2025-08-02.schoeps.spyder9.flac16**: taped by Dan Nolan, Jr. - spyder9; transferred by Dan Nolan, Jr. - spyder9; source: Schoeps CMC 1 KC5 mk22 > Zoom F6 (24/44.1) [5]. Also: Schoeps CMC 1 mics with KC5 capsules into a Zoom F6 at 16 bit; taped, edited and transferred by Spyder9 Studios [5]
- **deadandco2025-08-02.nak1k.spyder9.flac16**: taped by Dan Nolan, Jr. - spyder9; transferred by Dan Nolan, Jr. - spyder9; source: Nakamichi CM-1000 CP-101 (Sank P48) > Zoom F6 (24/44.1) [6]. Also: Nakamichi CM-1000 mics with CP-101 capsules into a Zoom F6 at 16 bit; taped, edited and transferred by Spyder9 Studios [6]
